hypotheses.R1_raw_top64_recovers_tail: The raw weight tensor's top 64 output directions capture at least 75% of the frozen residual-tail output-4 subspace.
hypotheses.R2_natural_weighting_improves_early_reco: Natural input-covariance weighting improves tail-4 coverage at rank 16 by at least 0.20 over the raw weight ordering.
hypotheses.R3_tail_axes_have_compact_input_forms: Four input eigenmodes contain at least 50% of exact interaction-form energy for every residual-tail axis.
hypotheses.R4_weight_formula_predicts_tail_edits: For every tail axis and corpus, the exact quadratic form predicts finite top-mode scalar effects with correlation at least 0.99.
hypotheses.R5_tail_top_modes_are_scalar_specific: For every tail axis and corpus, top-mode edits have at least four times the median absolute scalar effect of low-mode edits.
hypotheses.R6_tail_top_modes_reach_behavior: For at least three of four tail axes on every corpus, top-mode edits have at least four times the median final-logit KL of low-mode edits.
hypotheses.R7_pca_axes_are_semantically_privileged: The observed tail-PCA axis alignment to structural output-token predicates exceeds 64 random rotations of the same tail-4 subspace.
hypotheses.R8_tail_axes_have_simple_output_roles: Every residual-tail axis has best structural output-token AUROC at least 0.70.
